lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 8 high-contrast vertical lines; spacing is relatively wide in the mid-torso and becomes progressively narrower towards the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior torso line terminates mid-flank; the final two posterior lines are significantly abbreviated, appearing only on the upper haunch.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 3 distinct white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch, located superior to the white inguinal hair patch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the lower haunch exhibit a near-vertical alignment.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Double-curved lyrate trajectory; horns diverge laterally from the frontal bone, then curve medially before extending vertically at the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between the terminal tips is approximately 1.5 times the combined width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Bright ivory-colored tips represent approximately the distal 10-12% of the total horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron between the eyes, three distinct white spots on the lower cheek, and a continuous white dorsal hair ridge.
